title: Priesthood of Believers
definition: The Priesthood of Believers teaches that all Christians have access to God through Christ and are called to offer spiritual sacrifices.
summary: The Priesthood of Believers teaches that all Christians have direct access to God through Christ and are called to offer spiritual service.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the great High Priest who opens access to the Father for His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The priesthood of believers means all Christians have access to God through Christ and are called to offer spiritual worship and service. Scripture does not restrict nearness to God to a special spiritual class.

This doctrine does not erase leadership or order in the church. It teaches that every believer may draw near to God, pray, serve, witness, and minister according to grace.

Jesus is the great High Priest who opens the way to the Father. Because of Him, believers come near with confidence and serve as a holy priesthood.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Some believers feel spiritually second-class or dependent on leaders to approach God for them. The priesthood of believers restores dignity, access, and responsibility in Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Draw near to God personally through Jesus, and use your life as spiritual worship. Do not hide behind leaders; pray, serve, witness, and encourage others as someone given access by Christ.
